books.title: Addawatul Makkiya
books.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan
books.description: A scholarly treatise by Imam Ahmad Raza Khan establishing the beliefs of Ahle Sunnat regarding the Prophet's knowledge of the unseen (ilm-e-ghaib) and other extraordinary virtues granted by Allah. It presents Quranic verses, hadiths, and rational arguments to refute objections and affirm the comprehensive knowledge bestowed upon the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).

recommendations.reason: Same author and category — a deeper refutation work
Another classic by Imam Ahmad Raza Khan
Foundational beliefs of Ahle Sunnat

books.title: Ahle Sunnat Ki Pehchan
books.author: Allama Ghulam Rasool Qasmi
books.description: A book discussing the beliefs and practices of Ahle Sunnat, covering topics such as the importance of following the Quran and Sunnah, the status of companions, the concept of bid'ah, and the characteristics of true believers versus hypocrites. It presents various hadiths and arguments to establish the Sunni creed and refute sectarian divisions.

recommendations.reason: Deepen your understanding of Sunni creed
Learn Islamic rulings after mastering beliefs

books.title: Al Amnu wal Ula
books.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan
books.description: A detailed refutation by Imam Ahmad Raza Khan addressing Wahhabi objections against the beliefs of Ahle Sunnat. It covers the status of the Prophet, intercession (tawassul), tasawwur-e-shaykh, visiting the Prophet's grave, seeking blessings (tabarruk), and venerating saints, defending the orthodox Sunni position with Quranic verses and hadith.

recommendations.reason: Same author — another scholarly refutation
The Quran translation by the same great scholar
Foundational beliefs before advanced refutations

books.title: Anwaar e Shariat
books.author: Allama Mufti Jalaluddin Ahmad Amjadi
books.description: A comprehensive guide to Islamic beliefs and Hanafi jurisprudence by Mufti Jalaluddin Ahmad Amjadi. The first part covers articles of faith including Allah's attributes, angels, divine books, prophets, and the Day of Judgment. The second part provides detailed rulings on purification, prayer, fasting, and other acts of worship according to the Hanafi school.

recommendations.reason: Master beliefs before diving into fiqh details
Understand the Sunni identity and creed

books.title: Aqaid e Ahle Sunnat
books.author: Allama Tariq Anwar Misbahi
books.description: An exposition of the core beliefs of Ahlus Sunnah Wal Jama'ah by Allama Tariq Anwar Misbahi. The book systematically covers the Islamic creed including beliefs about Allah, His prophets, angels, divine scriptures, the Day of Judgment, and destiny, presenting the authentic Sunni position on each topic with reference to Quran and Hadith.

recommendations.reason: Further reading on identifying Ahle Sunnat
Now study the rulings of Shariah

books.title: Ikhteyarat e Mustafa
books.description: A unique work exploring the special prerogatives and choices granted exclusively to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) by Allah. It discusses matters where the Prophet was given authority to make exceptions to general rulings, including intercession on the Day of Judgment, forgiveness of sins, exemption from certain prohibitions, and other distinctive honors bestowed upon him.

recommendations.reason: A gentle journey through the Prophet's life
Deep dive into the Prophet's virtues and rights

books.title: Kanzul Iman
books.subtitle: Quran Tarjama by Alahazrat
books.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan
books.description: The celebrated Urdu translation of the Holy Quran by Imam Ahmad Raza Khan (A'la Hazrat), presented in Roman Urdu transliteration. Regarded as one of the most eloquent and spiritually profound Urdu translations, it combines linguistic precision with deep devotional reverence, making the divine message accessible to readers worldwide.

recommendations.reason: A scholarly work by the same translator
Another masterpiece by Imam Ahmad Raza Khan
Understand the beliefs behind the translation

books.title: Maqalaat e Ahsani
books.author: Muhammad Qasim Qadri
books.description: A collection of scholarly articles by Muhammad Qasim Qadri addressing a wide range of Islamic topics. The articles cover refutations of deviant ideologies, Islamic history, principles of jurisprudence, contemporary issues, and spiritual guidance, offering insightful perspectives rooted in the teachings of Quran and Sunnah.

recommendations.reason: Build a strong foundation in Sunni beliefs
Further reading on identifying true Sunni creed

books.title: Mukashafatul Quloob
books.description: A spiritual work on the purification of the heart, presented by Dawat-e-Islami. It explores the reality of death, the grave, the Day of Judgment, Heaven and Hell, the importance of sincere repentance, and the means to achieve spiritual excellence and closeness to Allah through the remembrance and love of the Creator.

recommendations.reason: Continue the journey into the afterlife
Connect your heart to the Prophet's seerah
The Quran — the ultimate source of spiritual healing

books.title: Qayamat Kab Aayegi
books.author: Allama Abdul Mustafa Aazmi
books.description: A comprehensive collection of 50 authentic hadiths about the Day of Judgment compiled by Allama Abdul Mustafa Aazmi. It covers the major and minor signs of Qiyamah, the events of the Last Day, resurrection, reckoning, the scale of deeds, intercession (shafa'at), Paradise, and Hellfire, providing a complete Islamic perspective on eschatology based on authentic traditions.

recommendations.reason: Another book by the same author on the Prophet's life
Spiritual preparation for the Hereafter
The Prophet's intercession on the Day of Judgment

books.title: Seerat e Mustafa
books.subtitle: A gentle seerah reading journey
books.author: Allama Abdul Mustafa Al Aazmi
books.description: A gentle and accessible biography of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) by Allama Abdul Mustafa Al Aazmi, published by Dawat-e-Islami. It takes the reader through a soul-nurturing journey of the Prophet's blessed life, his noble character, his teachings, and the timeless lessons from his seerah for daily living.

recommendations.reason: Explore the special choices of the Prophet
A comprehensive work on the Prophet's virtues
Another book by the same author

books.title: Shifa Shareef
books.subtitle: Roman Urdu
books.author: Qadi Iyad
books.description: The Roman Urdu rendering of the classical work Ash-Shifa by Qadi Iyad, a celebrated text on the status and virtues of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It comprehensively covers the Prophet's excellences as attested in the Quran, his miracles, his noble character, the rights of the Prophet upon his ummah, and the legal rulings concerning reverence for him.

recommendations.reason: A gentle seerah journey after studying the Prophet's virtues
The special choices granted to the Prophet
Read the same masterpiece in the original Urdu

books.title: Shifa Shareef - Vol 1
books.subtitle: Urdu
books.author: Qadi Iyad
books.description: The Urdu translation of the classical masterpiece Ash-Shifa by Qadi Iyad, one of the most authoritative works on the dignity, rights, and virtues of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It covers the Prophet's excellences as attested in the Quran, his miracles, the obligation to love and honor him, and the legal rulings regarding respect for the Prophet.

recommendations.reason: A gentle journey through the Prophet's blessed life
The special honors bestowed upon the Prophet
The same work in Roman Urdu transliteration
